headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of September 16, 2026, the portfolio set is showing an average return of 22.83%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 11.28%. This results in an average alpha of 11.55%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also ahead of the benchmark. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 48.24%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 5.70%, but still reflects the overall strength of the portfolio set. Outperforming SPY during this period is a useful signal, particularly amid broader market uncertainties. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
